project_type: Suno AI songwriting knowledge base — Markdown documentation toolkit with a thin Kiro agent automation layer. NOT a code project; all deliverables are Markdown.
language: Markdown (docs). One Python validator (tools/validate-song.py) exists but is OUT OF SCOPE and must not be run for this task (it enforces v5.5 song-file rules irrelevant to toolkit docs).
build_system: None. No compile/build. No package manager.
test_framework: None applicable. tools/validate-song.py validates SONG files against v5.5 rules; it is NOT a test suite for toolkit docs and must NOT be used here.
test_command: N/A. Do NOT run tools/validate-song.py. Verification is manual/structural: confirm files exist, YAML frontmatter is well-formed, #[[file:...]] include paths resolve to real files, README/CHANGELOG/WORKFLOW tables are internally consistent.
verification_instructions: 1) Confirm each new file exists at the specified path. 2) Confirm every #[[file:...]] include in new/edited agents points to an existing file (grep the path). 3) Confirm no craft rule (12 critique categories, prosody thresholds, hook timing, V2-new-info, bridge-turn, 70/30) is REDEFINED in new files — they must reference core/methodology/critique.md and core/methodology/songwriting.md instead. 4) Confirm README Agents table now lists 6 agents incl. song-planner and SOP table lists SOP 09. 5) Confirm CHANGELOG [Unreleased]/Added has bullets for the planner package and guided writing mode. 6) git diff review.
setup_instructions: None. Work directly on files. Create a new git branch off main before editing; commit at the end. Do NOT push or open a PR.
environment_constraints: Do NOT push, do NOT open PRs (orchestrator handles publishing). Do NOT run tools/validate-song.py. Work on a NEW branch off main. Repo path: /projects/sandbox/songwriting-kb, currently on branch main (HEAD = merge of PR #10, contains all V6 work).
contribution_requirements: ARCHITECTURE IS THE #1 CONSTRAINT (see core/tenets.md tenet 4 ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH and README Architecture section). core/methodology/*.md is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for craft logic. .kiro/agents/*.md are THIN: YAML frontmatter (name, description with trigger phrases, tools) + Behavioral Directives + #[[file:...]] includes that load methodology. Agents contain NO craft logic. .kiro/sops/*.md are step-by-step procedures that POINT TO core/methodology. NEVER fork/duplicate craft definitions; reference the canonical file. Guided modes are a new INTERACTION MODE over EXISTING methodology + critique rubric, never new craft rules.
key_patterns: Agent frontmatter pattern (see .kiro/agents/songwriter.md, builder.md): --- name / description (prose listing trigger phrases) / tools: ["read","write","web"] --- then # Agent title, ## Behavioral Directives, ## Creative Tenets with #[[file:core/tenets.md]], ## Methodology with #[[file:core/methodology/X.md]], ## Reference Data includes. SOP pattern (see .kiro/sops/01,07): # SOP NN: Title, > blockquote note pointing to canonical methodology, ## Prerequisites, ## Procedure with PHASE/Step structure, ## Output, ## Time Estimate, ## Common Mistakes. Methodology file pattern (see core/methodology/songwriting.md): # The X Method, > CANONICAL blockquote, Three-Tier Evidence Labeling table, phased steps, References section pointing to references/. Songwriter agent already has INTERACTIVE MODE and AUTO-PILOT MODE sections with explicit trigger-phrase lists.
